thread:
felix: sales flagged RetailCo asking for a 12mo commit but with month-to-month flexible burst allocations for peak seasons, plus the ability to carry over unused burst credits for a few months. can product/infra/legal scope this?
anya: yes — suggest a new product: "Seasonal Flex Pack". Core ideas: monthly committed baseline + an attachable burst pool that customers can reallocate per month via API/console; allow limited carryover (e.g., 1	60-day carryover for Pro, 3-month for Enterprise). Limit MVP to embeddings + rerank routes to reduce scope.
jordan: infra implications: we need a per-customer monthly ledger, cross-route rebalancer, carryover accounting, and audit trail for finance. Also add billing hooks for reallocation events. Rough estimate: 3 infra sprints for ledger + rebalancer + monitoring; 1 sprint for billing integration.
nina: pricing sketches: three SKUs: Flex Lite (committed baseline, no carryover), Flex Pro (committed + 1-month carryover + limited reallocations), Flex Enterprise (committed + 3-month carryover + regional allocation + SLA/support). Anchors (ballpark): Lite $9k/mo, Pro $16k/mo, Enterprise $34k/mo (includes SLA buffer). Include per-million-burst topping price.
iqbal: legal flags: carryover + reallocation increases exposure. Recommend: explicit credit cap (e.g., max credits payable = 50% monthly fee), overage multiplier for unplanned ops (e.g., 1.5x per-op), early-termination fee if cancel within initial 6mo, and explicit force-majeure/residency carveouts. Avoid absolute "guarantee" language; use "commercially reasonable efforts" for capacity availability.
mona-legal: I'll draft the carryover/reallocation clause and credit calc; will provide two variants (Hosted vs Private) — private deployment may need higher fees and KMS/residency language.
ops-bot: created ticket PROD-9009: Seasonal Flex Pack (assignee: anya)
anya: proposed launch acceptance: 1) billing SKUs & price table, 2) console + API endpoints for monthly allocation & reallocation, 3) ledger + audit trail + dashboards for usage & carryover, 4) fallback policy (auto-fallback to best-effort + overage billing) + clear notification behavior, 5) runbook + SRE oncall for pilot, 6) legal-approved term sheet.
felix: negotiation levers for RetailCo: cap monthly burst (e.g., 2M ops), define carryover window, automatic fallback when pool exhausted, 30d cancellation notice, and pilot for peak-months only. Sales confirm?
iqbal: sales: RetailCo is okay with pilot constraints but will push for a price cap and a swap option to shift commit between regions once per year. flag finance for exposure analysis.
jordan: infra followups: need token-bucket changes to support carryover credits and reallocation API; require per-customer pre-warm pool to respect short-notice peaks. We'll sketch telemetry and costs in the sprint plan.
anya: owners: anya (product & API), jordan (infra & telemetry), nina (pricing), mona-legal (contract drafts), iqbal (sales). Weekly sync Wednesdays 10am PT.
anya: I'll drop an initial spec + API contract by Thursday.
jordan: infra breakdown & cost sensitivity by Friday EOD.
mona-legal: draft contract variants by Monday.
felix: thanks team :thumbsup:
